items.stem: Midway through a predictive project, the sponsor requests a significant new feature. What is the project coordinator's most appropriate first step?

options.text: Submit the change through the integrated change-control process for evaluation
options.rationale: Correct: changes to a baselined predictive project go through integrated change control before acceptance.

options.text: Immediately build the feature without analysis
options.rationale: Acting before change control risks scope, cost and schedule baselines.
A single change request does not warrant cancellation.
Ignoring a legitimate stakeholder request is not appropriate project behaviour.

items.explanation: Correct: changes to a baselined predictive project go through integrated change control before acceptance.

items.stem: Which statement best captures a core value of the agile mindset?

options.text: Responding to change over following a fixed plan
options.rationale: Correct: agile values responding to change over rigidly following a plan.
Agile favours working outcomes over exhaustive documentation.

options.text: Avoiding any customer contact until delivery
Fixing all scope, cost and time with no flexibility
options.rationale: That describes a strictly predictive stance, not the agile mindset.

items.explanation: Correct: agile values responding to change over rigidly following a plan.
